name: DisequalityDispersion.epsAlphabet_gt
typeText:
∀ (L M : Nat) (ε : Rat),
  And (LT.lt.{0} L (DisequalityDispersion.epsAlphabet L M ε))
    (LT.lt.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (↑M) ε)) ↑(DisequalityDispersion.epsAlphabet L M ε))

source.code:
theorem epsAlphabet_gt (L M : ℕ) (ε : ℚ) :
    L < epsAlphabet L M ε ∧ (1 + (M : ℚ) / ε) < epsAlphabet L M ε := by
  unfold epsAlphabet
  constructor
  · omega
  · have h1 := Nat.le_ceil (1 + (M : ℚ) / ε)
    have h2 : (⌈1 + (M : ℚ) / ε⌉₊ : ℚ) ≤ max (L : ℚ) (⌈1 + (M : ℚ) / ε⌉₊ : ℚ) :=
      le_max_right _ _
    push_cast
    linarith
